about_the_game:
Pressure Point is an anime, mystery, visual novel in development; Set in a fantasy World War 2 setting in the confines of a submerged submarine. Your crew of crewmates find their vessel sabotaged along it's path towards completing it's mission and must collectively decide who has attempted to poison your voyage. Beware however, as there is only a single weapon on board: A handgun wielded by the Captain herself,. and only she will make executions. 

Can you route out the traitors on your ship and help it reach the final destination to save your allies from a watery grave? Or will you go down with the ship once you learn more about the mission you're truly involved in? Keep your head above water because the deeper the mystery gets...the closer you get to the Pressure Point.

==AI ART DISCLOSURE==
All of the AI art shown is entirely placeholder and will be replaced as the game approaches release.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 7
  • Processor: 2.8 GHz Intel Core 2 or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2 or DirectX 9.0 compatible GPU with a minimum of 1GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Collect evidence behind traitorous activity aboard your submarine, interview your crewmates, and dig deeper into the mystery behind your country's goals. By the power of democracy: collectively argue, present evidence, and vote on who aboard are traitors to your cause...then...execute them!
